description: 서울특별시_하천 수위 현황 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 서울특별시. 서울시내 하천 수위 정보를 수위계(수위를 측정하는 계기)명, 하천명, 구청명, 시간하천 수위값(단위:m), 제방고(단위:m), 계획송수위, 하상고(하천바닥의 표고), 침수수위, 통제수위. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
